posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
G-Unity seems to be filled with thematic goodies rather than outright mechanical dominance.  Blowing up an Electro-Pulse Explosive or one of Voss's ships is cool thematically rather than a consistent mechanical benefit.  Unity blowing up villain Devices is something fans speculated about for a month or two when she was revealed in the Kickstarter.  If it doesn't sound terribly fun to you, then I recommend playing her exclusively against villains with Devices or doing your best to keep her alive (which is a game in and of itself).

I'd rather have a specialized, thematically interesting incapacitated power than an innate power that just zaps 4-18 HP targets for free.
